blocos.texto: So Morde is the usual illaoi counter people go for however this matchup is rather easy when you understand how it works. I'm only putting the matchup hard just because most league players are silver to emerald Elo. If you go Grasp you can trade with him level 1 with W but make sure to not let him get 3 attacks off for his passive to activate. Try to stay with the minions since his Q does significantly less damage if you are not isolated. The matchup becomes tricky after level 6 since whenever he ults you lose all of your tentacles. Now I'm gonna give you tips on how to beat a Morde after level 6. If you pull his spirit he will most likely walk up and try to E you so don’t attack the spirit right after you pull it, try to dodge his E or Q whenever he walks up. If you pull the spirit he will also try to ult you since the spirit will be gone in the shadow realm so make sure to not forget that. You can cancel his ult with your ult, the timing is very precise so make sure to watch for his animations. If you pull his soul and he ults you and you QSS to get out, the spirit will be gone when you come back but the tentacles will stay. If a jungler comes to gank you, make sure you pull the jungler's spirit and ult since if Morde ults you and you QSS the spirit for the junglers will still be there unlike if you pulled Morde's spirit. You beat him in the side lane after you get your items.
